output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly a build effect, not a flag effect. Build 7.4.0 was crashing at about 2% from 2 Sep, before any flag ramp, while 7.3.2 stayed near 0.7%. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so flagged users are all on the new build. Within 7.4.0, flag-on and holdout users crash at nearly the same rate (2.10% vs 1.98%, difference not distinguishable from zero). Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The app store's own crash counts agree with the crash reporter, so this isn't a reporting artifact. The sync-service deploy didn't change 7.3.2's rate. The leading 7.4.0 crash is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda, HEIF decoding), first seen 2 Sep.
Don't do the director's plan: it would ship the real crash to 100% of users and close the incident with the cause unfixed. Hold 7.4.0 at 25%, and fix or roll back the Pixelda upgrade. Keep the flag as is, and keep the holdout running (widening it to 30% would speed up the check) to rule out a small flag effect of a few tenths of a point. I'm fairly confident, with the small flag effect still unresolved.
